description: Java source code defining the FeaturesRoute class, which sets up REST API endpoints for managing features of a thing, including CRUD operations for features, their definitions, properties, and nested paths. It uses Akka HTTP for route definitions and interacts with other components for handling specific commands and queries related to features.

classes.name: FeaturesRoute
classes.description: Defines HTTP routes for CRUD operations on features, feature definitions, properties, and nested paths within a thing. Uses Akka HTTP and interacts with command/query components to perform operations.

methods.name: buildFeaturesRoute
methods.description: Constructs the composite route for /features endpoint, including sub-routes for specific feature operations.

methods.name: features
methods.description: Handles GET, PUT, DELETE for /features, allowing retrieval, updating, and deletion of all features for a given thing.

methods.name: featuresEntry
methods.description: Handles operations for a specific feature identified by featureId, including get, put, delete.

methods.name: featuresEntryDefinition
methods.description: Handles operations for the definition of a specific feature, including get, put, delete.

methods.name: featuresEntryProperties
methods.description: Handles operations for properties of a specific feature, including get, put, delete.

methods.name: featuresEntryPropertiesEntry
methods.description: Handles operations on individual property entries within a feature, identified via JSON pointer, including get, put, delete.

methods.name: featuresEntryInboxOutbox
methods.description: Handles messaging endpoints for feature inbox/outbox messaging patterns.
